purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom construction law profiles that require displayed cost and charged cost parity. This is cost semantics evidence only; it does not prove construction UI hooks, resource mutation ordering, build commit, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: city owner to law-owner correlation proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: extra build slot counted as cost discount
cove.harbor-infrastructure-extra-build.notes: Cove construction cost parity requires matching displayed and charged costs for exact eligible infrastructure and keeps extra-build behavior separate.

fortress-fortification-extra-build.notes: Fortress construction cost parity requires matching displayed and charged costs for exact fortification/support groups and keeps extra-build behavior separate.

inferno-garrison-sacrifice-extra-build.notes: Inferno construction cost parity requires deterministic garrison sacrifice value to match displayed and charged gold offset before extra-build behavior.

stronghold-military-extra-build.notes: Stronghold construction cost parity requires matching displayed and charged ore discount for exact military groups and keeps extra-build behavior separate.

tower-magical-construct-workshop-slot.notes: Tower construction cost parity requires visible surcharge and charged surcharge to match for exact magical/construct groups while preserving normal-slot/workshop-slot distinction.
